stage.note: Only confirmed capital event found is participation in YC's Summer 2019 batch (YC's standard deal is a small pre-seed/seed investment); no press release, TechCrunch/Crunchbase-visible round, or investor list was found for any subsequent priced round. Company was tiny (2 employees per YC profile) and shut down its hosted services in 2025/2026, consistent with a company that never raised significant outside capital beyond YC.

note: KubeSail (YC S19, 'The Self-Hosting Company') shut down its hosted services in 2025/2026 after ~6 years; its own site now shows a farewell letter ('After six wonderful years, we've made the difficult decision to stop operating our hosted services... KubeSail is no longer accepting new users or selling hardware.'). Docs remain online for existing PiBox hardware owners; code remains open source on GitHub. The YC directory entry (website https://kubesail.com, batch Summer 2019, status Active) matches this provider's domain exactly, confirming the hint. No funding round beyond YC participation could be confirmed from public sources within the research budget.
